findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 921 requests to 175 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 89.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.1 MB (7%) came from third-party domains, 1.9 MB of it from services classified as tracking (632 requests).

89 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising).
425 cookies were set by third-party domains (481 cookies in total).
